reason: Indian libraries offered when finding a library (pop-up search, browse, near me and public API listings). An Indian directory library that is not listed here is left out of finding a library but still resolves by ID, so a reader who already chose one keeps it. Libraries outside India are not affected.

criteria.verified: At least one book confirmed by the strict standard: query match, the same record resolved and a live found from the app's own lookup (docs/research/india-library-hardening/summary.json).
criteria.egranthalayaAudit: e-Granthalaya libraries whose catalog returned books for at least one of the fifty titles in the 10 November 2026 audit (docs/research/india-library-hardening/egranthalaya-audit-20261110), without a strict one-book check.

rules: Generated by tools/catalog-hardening/library-status.mjs; do not edit by hand.
IDs are only added. A listed library stays listed even if a later check fails; failed lookups are logged for manual review.
To remove a library, delete its ID here by hand with a note in the commit, then regenerate the tracker.
